scope: Current installation: ordinary owner task through the existing shared core/worker, registered MCP gateway and own managed Chromium browser. Personal Chrome sharing is optional.

criteria.scope: ordinary owner conversation -> existing digital worker -> own managed browser
criteria.baseline: Own Chromium and registered MCP tools exist; stopped browser cannot start from actual tool use; context asks owner to start/share. Personal Chrome T3.2 remains accepted.
success: One ordinary conversation task opens the own browser from stopped with no owner UI action.
Real browser navigation and link follow succeed, destination title and URL are returned from observed page.
hardConditions: Do not resume owner-controlled browser or replay uncertain browser effects automatically.
Read-only public website task; no real home actions, messages, payments or private content.
notClaimed: All websites, logins, CAPTCHAs or downloads work.
General competitor superiority or lower model cost.

existing: Own isolated Chromium browser and Playwright MCP server
Owner-bound connector registry and authenticated ContextForge gateway
Host browser controller and persistent browser profile
Ordinary conversation and delegated digital worker
changes: Start the configured stopped browser only on authorized actual tool use
Default task context to own browser without requesting owner tab sharing
Exact compatible upstream compositor idle-frame fix
Retain owner- and browser-generation-bound private gateway session across browser tools

nativeOverlay.purpose: Keep Wayland frame callbacks running without a connected viewer so ordinary Playwright actions can complete their stability checks.

compatibility.retainedWire: H264 prefix 0x04 followed by 0x01=IDR, 0x02=I, 0x00=delta; no codec high nibble. EncodedStripe.data_type remains 1=JPEG, 2=H264.
compatibility.preflight: Separate target-directory import in the existing browser ABI found no missing existing CaptureSettings, ScreenCapture or StripeFrame fields/methods. API evidence is not viewer or task acceptance.
compatibility.versionLabelWarning: Do not substitute PyPI 2.1.0 (SHA256 43d47574e52f485d86b4b3d0f56c6bcf160e99ebc658cb59d7a096e6ee0ca1a0) or another 2.1.0 snapshot; that later build changes settings and the video wire protocol.

nativeOverlay.deploymentBoundary: Only the native package in the existing browser container; preserve profile and Selkies authentication overlay, use existing controller stop/start. No Computer Use API or Chromium flag change.
nativeOverlay.license: MPL-2.0; retain wheel licenses and bundled component notices

verification.candidateComposition: Both actual candidate images load identical digital profiles with existing runtime configuration.
verification.installedComposition: Both installed images healthy; all six source hashes match repository and core/worker profiles match.

independentSourceReview.scope: autostart, pinned compositor compatibility and browser-scoped session correction

independentFinalReview.scope: Installed current own-browser outcome only; earlier failures and limitations preserved.

limitations: No general guarantee for all websites, login, CAPTCHA, downloads or concurrent browser jobs.
Native overlay is installed in the current existing container; exact reconstruction is documented. Fresh optional browser installer remains separate O1 work.
No visual viewer acceptance or reboot/firewall recovery inferred from frame callback measurements.
ContextForge old session generations have no TTL; they are removed on session deletion or gateway shutdown. Rotation alone is not cleanup.
Model usage reports are partial; credits and Codex development cost are unknown. No competitor or speed/cost win claimed.

Ik heb in mijn eigen beheerde browser example.com bezocht en op ‘Learn more’ geklikt; jouw persoonlijke Chrome is niet gebruikt.
